definitions.strict_recovery: interrupted task + legal post-fault knowledge + public candidate + post-event alternate service + completion before deadline + zero security rejection
definitions.information_missing_or_stale: no legal knowledge or no public candidate after legal knowledge; this is not a claim that every such row has a publisher bug
definitions.time_or_physical_budget_insufficient_aft: a legal candidate existed, but the row did not complete before deadline; positive slack at knowledge is retained and does not prove zero time
definitions.information_present_but_execution_or_res: legal candidate existed but no post-event alternate service was recorded, without a separate deadline failure reason
definitions.not_an_interrupted_recovery_event: episode completed or failed without the reference execution being interrupted; excluded from event-recovery denominators
